newsitem.title: VIETNAM: SOCCER-REFEREE COPS IT IN VIETNAM SOCCER FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REFEREE COPS IT IN VIETNAM SOCCER FINAL.

text.p: Vietnam's national soccer final was marred by violence on Sunday when the losing Ho Chi Minh City Police force team attacked the referee.
Television pictures showed a rough and chaotic game during which a succession of injured players were carried off and nine yellow and red cards were shown.
But the climax came after the closing whistle when players from the police team, defeated 3-1 by the Dong Thap province side, pushed, kicked and punched the referee as he ran off the pitch.
Viewers of Sunday's game saw riot police run into the stadium to intervene, but the scenes of mayhem were cut from a rebroadcast shown on Monday.
Soccer skills in Vietnam have yet to reach international standards, but the game is followed with a passion.
